chrome.subtitle: Settings persisted in the database; they override .env for desktop installs. Changes apply immediately when possible; fields marked “restart” require a backend restart.
chrome.title: Settings
item.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL.label: Anthropic Opus model id
item.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL.desc: Override the default `claude-sonnet-*` model id used by Anthropic-backed sessions.
item.ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL.descript: Used by sub-agents and other cheap calls. Defaults to claude-haiku.
item.ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL.label: Anthropic small/fast model id
item.BRAVE_API_KEY.description: Powers the agent's web_search tool. Get a key at brave.com/search/api.
item.BRAVE_API_KEY.label: Brave Search API key
item.CODER_AGENTLESS_MODE.description: Pre-Agent-Loop-v2 behaviour. Mostly for regression testing.
item.CODER_AGENTLESS_MODE.label: Agentless mode
item.CODER_AGENT_LOOP_V2.description: Newer turn-management loop with dedup + protect-window heuristics. ON by default in newer builds.
item.CODER_AGENT_LOOP_V2.label: Agent Loop v2
item.CODER_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER.descriptio: When remaining context falls below this, trigger compaction.
item.CODER_AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER.label: Auto-compact buffer (tokens)
item.CODER_COMPACT_CUMULATIVE_RATIO.desc: Triggers compaction when cumulative tool-output across the run exceeds this multiple of the context window. Default 10.
item.CODER_COMPACT_MIN_TAIL_FRACTION.des: Floor on the recent tail expressed as a fraction of the visible renderable turns (0–0.6). The effective floor is the larger of this fraction and the min-tail-turns count. 0 disables the fractional floor. Default 0.10.
item.CODER_COMPACT_MIN_TAIL_TURNS.descri: Minimum number of recent renderable turns (user + assistant) always kept verbatim when compacting, regardless of token size — a floor so a token-dense tail can't collapse to nothing. Capped by the keep ratio so it never overflows the window. Default 8.
item.CODER_COMPACT_MIN_TAIL_TURNS.label: Compaction min tail turns
item.CODER_COMPACT_POLLING_TRIGGER_RATIO: Context-fill fraction (0–1) at which polling compaction kicks in. Default 0.5.
item.CODER_COMPACT_PRESERVE_LAST_N_TURNS: Number of recent turns left untouched during compaction.
item.CODER_COMPACT_PROTECT_RATIO.descrip: Fraction of the context window kept verbatim as the recent tail when compacting (the rest is summarized). Lower = cheaper but less recent detail. Default 0.30.
item.CODER_COMPACT_PROTECT_RATIO.label: Compaction keep ratio
item.CODER_COMPACT_STUCK_TURN_CAP.descri: Consecutive turns that fail to free window before compaction is treated as stuck. Default 8.
item.CODER_COMPACT_STUCK_TURN_CAP.label: Compaction stuck-turn cap
item.CODER_COMPACT_TRIGGER_RATIO.descrip: Fraction of the effective context window at which auto-compaction fires (one knob drives the size gate, the body gate at −0.05 and the token backstop). Default 0.90 — lower it to summarize earlier and keep more headroom.
item.CODER_COMPACT_TRIGGER_RATIO.label: Compaction trigger ratio
item.CODER_CONVERSATION_CHAPTERS.descrip: Persist every durable compaction as an immutable, searchable chapter. Disable to use the legacy single rolling summary.
item.CODER_CONVERSATION_CHAPTERS.label: Conversation chapters
item.CODER_COMPANY_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.descr: Time a company subordinate can sit idle before the orchestrator evicts it.
item.CODER_COMPANY_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Company idle timeout (ms)
item.CODER_COMPANY_MAX_SUBORDINATES.desc: How many subordinate workers the orchestrator may host at once.
item.CODER_COMPANY_ORCHESTRATOR_TTL_MS.d: Idle TTL for the orchestrator host itself.
item.CODER_DISABLED_MCP_TOOLS.descriptio: Comma-separated `mcp__*` tool names to hide from the registry. Useful to A/B a tool.
item.CODER_DISABLED_MCP_TOOLS.label: Disabled MCP tools
item.CODER_DISABLE_SUBAGENTS.description: Forces `spawn_subagent` / `spawn_agents` to refuse with an explanatory error.
item.CODER_DISABLE_SUBAGENTS.label: Disable sub-agents entirely
item.CODER_DOMINANCE_RATIO.description: Abort run when one tool exceeds this fraction of all calls in a window.
item.CODER_DOMINANCE_RATIO.label: Dominance guard ratio
item.CODER_DOMINANCE_WINDOW.label: Dominance window
item.CODER_DOOM_LOOP_FUZZY_THRESHOLD.des: Legacy rollback only: intervene after N same-tool-name calls across turns.
item.CODER_DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD.descripti: Legacy rollback only: intervene after N identical cross-turn tool-call sets. 0 disables.
item.CODER_DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD.label: Strict doom-loop threshold
item.CODER_DEDUP_POLICY.description: Hybrid coalesces local stable reads and observes cross-turn repetition; observe only records candidates; legacy restores the old global exact-args refusal.
item.CODER_DEDUP_POLICY.label: Tool dedup policy
item.CODER_FALLBACK_CHAIN.description: Comma-separated provider ids to try in order when the primary 5xx/429s.
item.CODER_FALLBACK_CHAIN.label: Provider fallback chain
item.CODER_GREP_PER_FILE_CAP.description: Cap matches per file in `grep_code` output to keep one hot file from drowning results.
item.CODER_GREP_PER_FILE_CAP.label: grep matches-per-file cap
item.CODER_IMPLEMENT_MAX_TURNS.descripti: Hard cap on turns in build/implement mode.
item.CODER_IMPLEMENT_MAX_TURNS.label: Build mode max turns
item.CODER_LOG_TOOLS_COUNT.description: Emits `[coder] N tools registered` on every turn so you can verify tier promotion.
item.CODER_LOG_TOOLS_COUNT.label: Log tool count per turn
item.CODER_MAX_AUTO_CONTINUES.descriptio: Extra max-turn batches allowed per run without a new user message. Effective ceiling: maxTurns × (1 + value). Recommended: 3; higher values are aggressive.
item.CODER_MAX_AUTO_CONTINUES.label: Max auto-continues per run
item.CODER_MAX_AUTO_CONTINUES.effective: Effective ceiling with maxTurns=50: {{turns}} turns per run.
item.CODER_MAX_AUTO_CONTINUES.warning: Above the recommended value 3; long autonomous runs cost more and carry more risk.
item.CODER_MCP_DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS.descri: Default max_tokens budget for MCP tool calls (e.g., mcp__search).
item.CODER_MCP_DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS.label: MCP tool default max_tokens
item.CODER_MCP_OUTPUT_HARD_CAP.descripti: Hard ceiling on chars returned by ANY mcp__* tool, regardless of caller-set limits.
item.CODER_MCP_OUTPUT_HARD_CAP.label: MCP tool output hard cap
item.CODER_MODEL_CAPS.description: JSON map of model id → capability flags. Advanced; see docs.
item.CODER_MODEL_CAPS.label: Model capability overrides
item.CODER_NEW_COMPACTION.description: Use the rolling-window compactor (vs the legacy summarizer).
item.CODER_NEW_COMPACTION.label: New compaction strategy
item.CODER_PARALLEL_AGENT_MAX.descriptio: How many `spawn_agents` workers can run concurrently.
item.CODER_PARALLEL_AGENT_MAX.label: Max parallel sub-agents
item.CODER_PREEMIT_COMPACT_MAX.descripti: Consecutive pre-send compaction attempts before the run stops with reason=compact_exhausted. Default 3.
item.CODER_PREEMIT_COMPACT_MAX.label: Pre-emit compaction cap
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT.description: A cheap model analyzes the first prompt of a fresh session and seeds it: minimal tool profile, pinned tools (incl. relevant external MCP tools), suggested skills, and which project memories to read. Runs zero-config — uses the code-agent/preflight binding (Admin → Pipelines) if set, otherwise the general default AI model. This is the kill-switch.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT.label: Task preflight (first-prompt analysis)
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_EXT_CATALOG_MAX.des: How many cached external MCP-server tools are shown to the preflight analyzer (input cap, bounds prompt cost). Native tools are always included; this only limits external tools. Set 0 to hide external MCP tools from preflight entirely.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_EXT_CATALOG_MAX.lab: Task preflight external MCP catalog cap
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_MAX_TOOLS.descripti: How many tools the analyzer may pin visible from turn 1.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_MAX_TOOLS.label: Task preflight max pinned tools
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_SKILLS_MAX.descript: How many active skills are shown to the preflight analyzer (input cap, bounds prompt cost). The analyzer suggests a small subset of these as task-relevant. Set 0 to disable skill suggestions.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_SKILLS_MAX.label: Task preflight skills catalog cap
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS.descript: Hard ceiling for the preflight one-shot call. The first message of a fresh session BLOCKS on this analysis (the chat shows an "Analyzing the task…" indicator while it runs); on timeout the call is cancelled and the session starts unseeded. Buffered providers (z.ai, ChatGPT) need ~10-12s for a complete response, so the default is generous.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Task preflight timeout (ms)
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_CAP.descrip: Seeded sessions cap their visible tool list at min(model cap, this). NEVER_TRIM tools and preflight pins always survive; hidden tools stay callable via find_tools.
item.CODER_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_CAP.label: Task preflight visible-tool cap
item.CODER_PROFILE.description: Which tool tiers start active. `auto` picks based on the user's first message.
item.CODER_PROFILE.label: Default coder profile
item.CODER_PROFILE_AUTO.description: Inspect the first user message to pick bootstrap/navigate/full when profile is unset.
item.CODER_PROFILE_AUTO.label: Auto-profile from first message
item.CODER_PROMPTS_WATCH.description: Watch packages/code-agent/src/prompts/*.txt and rebuild the system prompt on save. Useful when iterating on prompt copy.
item.CODER_PROMPTS_WATCH.label: Hot-reload system prompts
item.CODER_PRUNE_MINIMUM.description: Minimum total history chars before auto-compaction triggers. Below this, compaction is a no-op. Default 20000.
item.CODER_PRUNE_MINIMUM.label: Auto-compaction trigger (chars)
item.CODER_PRUNE_PROTECT.description: Chars of recent history protected from compaction. Only tool_results older than this window are pruned. Default 40000.
item.CODER_PRUNE_PROTECT.label: Compaction protect window (chars)
item.CODER_PUSH_TIME_CAP.description: Max chars per tool_result block written into history before truncation (main runner). Lower to save context; raise for verbose tools. Default 24000.
item.CODER_PUSH_TIME_CAP.label: Tool-result block cap (chars)
item.CODER_READ_DUP_THRESHOLD.descriptio: Observe the Nth same-path/slice read for mutation and context coverage. Only legacy mode refuses it.
item.CODER_READ_DUP_THRESHOLD.label: read_file dup threshold
item.CODER_READ_DUP_WINDOW.description: Turn window for read mutation, visibility, and legacy rollback checks.
item.CODER_READ_DUP_WINDOW.label: read_file dup window
item.CODER_READ_FILE_AUTOFULL_DISABLE.de: When set, agent must always pass an explicit range to read_file.
item.CODER_READ_FILE_HARD_MAX.descriptio: Maximum file size that read_file returns. Above this it errors with a hint.
item.CODER_READ_FILE_HARD_MAX.label: read_file hard max bytes
item.CODER_RECOVERY_400_MAX.description: Max 400 (bad-request) repair retries in a run before aborting with reason=recovery_capped. Default 3.
item.CODER_RECOVERY_400_MAX.label: Recovery cap — 400 retries
item.CODER_RECOVERY_401_MAX.description: Max 401 (auth) token-refresh attempts before aborting. Default 2.
item.CODER_RECOVERY_401_MAX.label: Recovery cap — 401 refreshes
item.CODER_RECOVERY_FALLBACK_MAX.descrip: Max provider-fallback switches before giving up. Default 5.
item.CODER_RECOVERY_FALLBACK_MAX.label: Recovery cap — provider fallbacks
item.CODER_RECOVERY_THINKING_MAX.descrip: Max thinking-only stream timeouts (reasoning ran past its budget without producing text/tools) before aborting. Each retry doubles the budget. Default 2.
item.CODER_RECOVERY_THINKING_MAX.label: Recovery cap — thinking-only timeouts
item.CODER_RECOVERY_TRANSIENT_MAX.descri: Max transient (429 / 5xx) retries across a run before aborting. Default 30.
item.CODER_RECOVERY_TRANSIENT_MAX.label: Recovery cap — transient retries
item.CODER_REDUCER_FLUSH_CHARS.descripti: Stale duplicate reads/searches are retired in batches of this many chars instead of one-by-one — each in-place retirement busts the provider prompt cache from that message on. 0 = retire immediately (legacy).
item.CODER_REDUCER_FLUSH_CHARS.label: Rolling reducer flush threshold (chars)
item.CODER_REPOMAP_TOKENS.description: Token budget for the auto-generated project repomap on turn 1.
item.CODER_REPOMAP_TOKENS.label: repomap budget (tokens)
item.CODER_REVIEW_MAX_TURNS.label: Reviewer subagent max turns
item.CODER_ROLLING_REDUCER.description: Reduce older tool_results on a rolling basis before size-based compaction, so sessions grow sublinearly. Set 0 to disable (diagnostics). Default 1.
item.CODER_ROLLING_REDUCER.label: Rolling-window reduction
item.CODER_SELF_REVIEW.description: Remind the agent to call self_review (the configured review pipeline over its own edits) when the session has pending changes. The self_review tool stays available either way.
item.CODER_SELF_REVIEW.label: Auto-review reminder
item.CODER_SPAWN_EXPLORE_MAX_TOOLS.descr: Max tool CALLS for an `explore` spawn_agent subagent (read-only). 0 = unlimited (codex-style): it runs until it concludes or trips the timeout/stall guards, instead of cutting investigation short. Default 0.
item.CODER_SPAWN_EXPLORE_MAX_TOOLS.label: spawn explore — tool-call budget
item.CODER_SPAWN_EXPLORE_STALL_MS.descri: Abort an `explore` spawn_agent subagent after this long without semantic progress. Default 90000 (90s).
item.CODER_SPAWN_EXPLORE_STALL_MS.label: spawn explore — stall threshold (ms)
item.CODER_SPAWN_EXPLORE_TIMEOUT_MS.desc: Hard timeout for an `explore` spawn_agent subagent. Default 600000 (10 min).
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_MAX_TOOLS.descript: Max tool CALLS for a `full` spawn_agent subagent (inherits the parent's exact toolset). Default 80.
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_MAX_TOOLS.label: spawn full — tool-call budget
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_STALL_MS.descripti: Abort a `full` spawn_agent subagent after this long without progress. Default 120000 (2 min).
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_STALL_MS.label: spawn full — stall threshold (ms)
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_TIMEOUT_MS.descrip: Hard timeout for a `full` spawn_agent subagent. Default 1200000 (20 min).
item.CODER_SPAWN_FULL_TIMEOUT_MS.label: spawn full — wall-clock timeout (ms)
item.CODER_SPAWN_IMPLEMENT_MAX_TOOLS.des: Max tool CALLS for an `implement` spawn_agent subagent (read+write+shell). Bounds blast radius — it mutates. Hitting it stops with reason=tool_budget (benign partial result). Default 80.
item.CODER_SPAWN_IMPLEMENT_STALL_MS.desc: Abort an `implement` spawn_agent subagent after this long without progress. Default 120000 (2 min).
item.CODER_SPAWN_IMPLEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.de: Hard timeout for an `implement` spawn_agent subagent. Default 1200000 (20 min).
item.CODER_STICKY_PROFILE.description: Persist the resolved tool profile/pins on the session and reuse them on resume (widen-only). Off = legacy per-run inference, which can flip the visible toolset between rounds and bust the provider prompt cache.
item.CODER_STICKY_PROFILE.label: Sticky tool profile per session
Max time to wait for the FIRST delta of any kind (time-to-first-byte). Reasoning models on heavy prompts can stay silent far longer than the inter-delta idle budget. Default 240000 (4 min).
item.CODER_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.descri: Max gap between consecutive provider deltas AFTER the first byte before the turn is aborted as a stalled stream. Default 90000 (90s).
item.CODER_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Stream — inter-delta idle timeout (ms)
item.CODER_STREAM_THINKING_ONLY_TIMEOUT_: Max time a provider stream may emit ONLY thinking deltas (no text/tool progress) before the turn is aborted and retried. Scaled up for high/xhigh reasoning effort and doubled per retry. Raise it if a reasoning model legitimately thinks longer. Default 240000 (4 min).
item.CODER_TASKS_DEFAULT_TOKEN_CAP.descr: Total token budget across a single `execute_tasks` run. When the projected next-task spend would exceed this, the orchestrator asks the user to extend, stop after the current task, or cancel pending. 0 / empty = unlimited (no cap). Default 0.
item.CODER_TASKS_DEFAULT_TOKEN_CAP.label: execute_tasks default token cap
item.CODER_TASKS_DISABLE_SKIP_STALE.desc: When on, `execute_tasks` always re-runs every task even if its file inputs (mtime/size + system prompt version) match a prior successful run. Use when side-effects outside the file scope might have changed (env, DB, external API).
item.CODER_TASK_IMPLEMENT_MAX_TOOLS.desc: Cap on tool invocations for an `implement` subagent (read + write + shell). Multiplied by complexity. Default 80.
item.CODER_TASK_IMPLEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.des: Maximum wall-clock duration for an `implement` subagent. Default 1200000 (20 min).
item.CODER_TASK_INVESTIGATE_MAX_TOOLS.de: Cap on tool invocations for an `investigate` subagent (read-only exploration). Multiplied by complexity (small 0.5x, large 2x) before enforcement. Default 40.
item.CODER_TASK_INVESTIGATE_TIMEOUT_MS.d: Maximum wall-clock duration for an `investigate` subagent. Default 600000 (10 min).
item.CODER_TASK_MAX_RETRIES.description: Number of EXTRA attempts after the first failure (so 2 = up to 3 total attempts). Retries only fire on transient errors (timeout, 5xx, 429, watchdog) — fatal errors (auth, validation) bail immediately. Default 2.
item.CODER_TASK_MAX_RETRIES.label: Task retry — max attempts
item.CODER_TASK_RETRY_INITIAL_MS.descrip: Wait before the first retry. Doubles each subsequent attempt (capped). Default 1000.
item.CODER_TASK_RETRY_INITIAL_MS.label: Task retry — initial backoff (ms)
item.CODER_TASK_RETRY_MAX_MS.description: Ceiling on the exponential backoff. Default 16000 (16s).
item.CODER_TASK_RETRY_MAX_MS.label: Task retry — max backoff (ms)
item.CODER_TASK_STALL_MS.description: No-progress threshold. The watchdog aborts a task subagent that emits NO tool calls or heartbeats for this long. Applies to every kind. Default 120000 (2 min).
item.CODER_TASK_STALL_MS.label: Task subagent — stall threshold (ms)
item.CODER_TASK_VERIFY_MAX_TOOLS.descrip: Cap on tool invocations for a `verify` subagent (tests/linters/lsp, no write). Multiplied by complexity. Default 30.
item.CODER_TASK_VERIFY_MAX_TOOLS.label: Verify task — max tool calls
item.CODER_TASK_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS.descri: Maximum wall-clock duration for a `verify` subagent. Default 900000 (15 min).
item.CODER_TASK_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Verify task — wall-clock timeout (ms)
item.CODER_WORKER_POST_RUN_LINGER_MS.des: Window the worker waits for a follow-up message before evicting. Default 30s.
item.CODER_WORKER_TTL_MS.description: How long an idle coder worker stays alive before eviction. Default 5 minutes.
item.CODER_WORKER_TTL_MS.label: Worker idle TTL (ms)
item.MCP_AGENT_WATCHDOG_MS.description: How long a company session may go with no activity (master idle, no subordinate running) before the dashboard shows a "stalled" banner with a manual nudge. Default 300000 (5 min).
item.MCP_AGENT_WATCHDOG_MS.label: Stall threshold (ms)
item.MCP_AGENT_WATCHDOG_TICK_MS.descript: How often the idle watchdog polls for a stalled session. Default 60000 (60s).
item.MCP_AGENT_WATCHDOG_TICK_MS.label: Stall check interval (ms)
item.MCP_AUTO_INDEX_MAX_FILES.descriptio: Projects with more candidate files than this skip the automatic run (status shows "too large — index manually").
item.MCP_AUTO_INDEX_MAX_FILES.label: Auto-index file cap
item.MCP_AUTO_INDEX_STRUCTURAL.descripti: Index symbols + FTS automatically when a project is opened (tree-sitter only — no LLM, no embeddings, $0). 0 disables.
item.MCP_AUTO_INDEX_STRUCTURAL.label: Auto structural index on open
item.MCP_AUTO_WATCH.description: Watch opened projects and re-index changed files incrementally (agents and search see edits live). 0 disables.
item.MCP_AUTO_WATCH.label: Real-time file watcher
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER.description: Isolates each chat session in its own worker_thread. Improves crash recovery + parallelism; off for fewer moving parts in dev.
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER.label: Run coder in a worker thread
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER_DEBUG.description: Dumps RPC + bus event breadcrumbs on worker crashes. Only useful with worker mode on.
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER_DEBUG.label: Verbose worker logs
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER_STRICT_CRASH.descr: Kills the worker on EVERY uncaught error (vs the default "keep alive on transient network errors"). Use when chasing a recurring bug.
item.MCP_CODER_WORKER_STRICT_CRASH.label: Strict worker crash policy
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_HEALTH_CHECK.desc: When on, send_to_agent fails fast if the target is unhealthy (overloaded / failed / stale) instead of queueing. Off keeps the legacy queue-and-wait behavior. Default 0.
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_MAX_PENDING.descr: A target agent is flagged "overloaded" (routing avoids it) once its pending+delivered inbox messages reach this. Default 3.
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_MAX_PENDING.label: Inbox max pending per target
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_STALE_IDLE_MS.des: A waiting/paused target whose last activity is older than this counts as "stale_idle" in the inbox health check. Default 300000 (5 min).
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS.d: How long a queued inbox message waits for delivery before it is marked EXPIRED. Default 1200000 (20 min).
Scans the cross-agent inbox for messages stuck pending/unanswered and expires or re-delivers them, so a blocked send_to_agent / send_to_master never hangs forever. Applies to new sessions.
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL: How often the inbox watchdog scans for stuck messages. Only relevant when the inbox watchdog is enabled. Default 30000 (30s).
item.MCP_COMPANY_INBOX_WATCHDOG_STUCK_MS: Pending/unanswered age after which the inbox watchdog expires or re-delivers a message. Default 300000 (5 min).
item.MCP_COMPANY_MASTER_NUDGE_MS.descrip: When a subordinate has been blocked waiting on the master (plan/question/tasks, or a master-bound inbox message) longer than this, the RuntimeReconciler re-wakes the master WITHOUT calling the LLM — re-emitting the attention signal or re-running inbox delivery. Bridges the gap to the 30-min MCP_SUBORDINATE_MASTER_WAIT_MS hard fallback so a single lost wake-up no longer strands a subordinate. 0 disables. Default 30000 (30s).
item.MCP_COMPANY_MASTER_NUDGE_MS.label: Master re-nudge threshold (ms)
item.MCP_COMPANY_RECONCILE_MS.descriptio: How often the company RuntimeReconciler reconciles in-memory runtime state with the DB. Default 45000 (45s).
item.MCP_COMPANY_RECONCILE_MS.label: Runtime reconciler cadence (ms)
item.MCP_DESKTOP_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED.d: Show native OS notifications when the target session or route is not visible.
Notify when a session or pipeline is blocked waiting for human input.
item.MCP_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_SESSION_FINISHED: Notify when a coder, pipeline, or company session finishes, pauses, fails, or aborts.
item.MCP_DEV_HTTP.description: Binds the in-process API to 127.0.0.1:7333 so you can hit endpoints from curl / a second tool. Off by default; the IDE uses mcp:// in-process dispatch instead.
item.MCP_DEV_HTTP.label: Expose Hono dev HTTP listener
item.MCP_DURABLE_COMPACTION.description: Persist automatic compaction (summary + recent tail) to the session so the next run starts compacted, reducing token cost across runs. Old messages stay reopenable via "view earlier history".
item.MCP_DURABLE_COMPACTION.label: Durable compaction
item.MCP_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.descrip: Wall-clock cap on HTTP requests, including the SSE streams that drive long `spawn_agents` runs. Node's default (300000ms = 5 min) was killing subagent explorations on big codebases. Default 3600000 (60 min). Lower to kill runaway runs faster; raise for 10k+ file projects. Restart required.
item.MCP_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.label: HTTP request timeout (ms)
item.MCP_INDEX_STRUCTURAL_WORKER.descrip: Run the structural pipeline in a dedicated worker_thread (keeps the app responsive). 0 forces in-process (debug).
item.MCP_INDEX_STRUCTURAL_WORKER.label: Structural index in worker thread
item.MCP_LSP_AUTO_PROMPT.description: Show the non-modal "Install PHP/Python support?" banner when a file of that language is opened and no server is installed. 0 hides it (install stays available in Admin).
item.MCP_LSP_AUTO_PROMPT.label: Offer language-server install
item.MCP_LSP_ENABLED.description: Run installed LSP servers (Intelephense/Pyright/…) for completion, hover and diagnostics. 0 disables — the structural-index fallback and the built-in TypeScript service keep working.
item.MCP_LSP_ENABLED.label: External language servers
item.MCP_LSP_IDLE_MS.description: Stop an LSP server process after this long without requests (it restarts transparently on the next use). Frees 100-300 MB per idle project.
item.MCP_LSP_IDLE_MS.label: Language server idle timeout (ms)
item.MCP_LSP_WORKER.description: Run the built-in TypeScript service and index-fallback queries in a dedicated worker_thread so completions/diagnostics never block the app. 0 forces in-process (debug).
item.MCP_LSP_WORKER.label: Language intelligence in worker thread
item.MCP_LSP_WORKER_IDLE_MS.description: Evict the language worker after this long with no compute in flight (open buffers replay transparently on the next use). Frees the TypeScript program heap.
item.MCP_LSP_WORKER_IDLE_MS.label: LSP worker idle timeout (ms)
item.MCP_MAX_SANDBOXES.description: Upper bound on live containers; new provisions block/evict past this. Default 10.
item.MCP_MAX_SANDBOXES.label: Max concurrent sandboxes
item.MCP_MEMORY_ARCHIVE_IMPORTANCE_MAX.d: Garbage-collect only snapshots below this importance (0–1). Default 0.35.
item.MCP_MEMORY_ARCHIVE_MAX_ACCESS.descr: Only archive snapshots accessed at most this many times. Default 1.
item.MCP_MEMORY_ARCHIVE_MAX_ACCESS.label: Archive: max access count
item.MCP_MEMORY_ARCHIVE_UNUSED_DAYS.desc: Only archive snapshots untouched for at least this many days. Default 90.
item.MCP_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE.description: Periodically merges near-duplicate memory snapshots and archives fully-stale, cold, low-importance ones. Archiving is reversible (restore from the project Memory tab). Runs only on idle projects whose memory changed since the last pass. Off by default (opt-in): set to 1 to arm.
item.MCP_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE.label: Memory consolidator (merge dups + archive stale)
item.MCP_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE_IDLE_MS.desc: A project must have had no activity for at least this long to be eligible for a pass. Default 1800000 (30 min).
How often the consolidator wakes to scan idle projects. Default 21600000 (6h).
item.MCP_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE_MAX_PROJECTS: Upper bound on how many idle projects one consolidation pass processes. Default 3.
item.MCP_MEMORY_IDLE_AFTER_MS.descriptio: How long a session must sit idle before the sweeper distills its pending span. Default 600000 (10 min).
item.MCP_MEMORY_IDLE_AFTER_MS.label: Memory sweeper idle threshold (ms)
item.MCP_MEMORY_MAX_MERGES_PER_PASS.desc: Caps how many duplicate clusters get merged per project in a single pass. Default 50.
item.MCP_MEMORY_MAX_MERGES_PER_PASS.labe: Max merges per project per pass
item.MCP_MEMORY_MAX_SNAPSHOTS_PER_PASS.d: Bounds the work per project; projects with more snapshots are handled across multiple passes. Default 500.
item.MCP_MEMORY_MERGE_COSINE.description: Embedding cosine similarity at/above which two snapshots are treated as the same fact and merged. Default 0.92.
item.MCP_MEMORY_MERGE_COSINE.label: Merge cosine threshold
item.MCP_MEMORY_MERGE_TITLE_JACCARD.desc: Title token Jaccard threshold used to detect duplicates when no embedding backend is available. Default 0.6.
item.MCP_MEMORY_SWEEPER.description: Distills durable project memory from sessions that went idle (≥10 min) with un-distilled messages. Complements the compaction-time harvest so short sessions also feed project memory. Default on.
item.MCP_MEMORY_SWEEPER.label: Idle memory sweeper
item.MCP_SANDBOX_AUTO_IDLE_REAPER.descri: Proactively reaps idle sandboxes on a timer (vs on-demand). Off by default.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_AUTO_IDLE_REAPER.label: Auto idle reaper
item.MCP_SANDBOX_BINARY.description: Binary the network controller shells out to. Default docker.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_BINARY.label: Runtime binary (network controller)
item.MCP_SANDBOX_BIND_MOUNT.description: Bind-mounts the session workdir into the sandbox so edits are live. On by default; set 0 for a copy-in model.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_BIND_MOUNT.label: Bind-mount host workdir
item.MCP_SANDBOX_CPUS.label: CPU limit
How long a paused sandbox is kept before full teardown. Default 86400000 (24h).
item.MCP_SANDBOX_DEV_PORT.description: Port the dev server listens on inside the sandbox (mapped to a host port). Default 5173 (Vite).
item.MCP_SANDBOX_DEV_PORT.label: In-container dev port
item.MCP_SANDBOX_DROP_CAPS.description: Drops every capability for defense-in-depth. Off by default (some tooling needs caps). Set 1 to harden.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_DROP_CAPS.label: Drop all Linux capabilities
item.MCP_SANDBOX_EGRESS_FIREWALL.descrip: When on, routes sandbox traffic through an allow-listed proxy/network. Off by default (direct egress).
item.MCP_SANDBOX_EGRESS_FIREWALL.label: Egress firewall
item.MCP_SANDBOX_HTTP_PROXY.description: Forces sandbox HTTP(S) through this proxy (pairs with a deny-egress network). Empty = direct.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_HTTP_PROXY.label: HTTP proxy
item.MCP_SANDBOX_IDLE_MS.description: How long an idle sandbox lives before the reaper pauses/evicts it. Default 1800000 (30 min).
item.MCP_SANDBOX_IDLE_MS.label: Sandbox idle TTL (ms)
item.MCP_SANDBOX_MEMORY.description: Per-sandbox memory cap (Docker/Podman syntax, e.g. "1g", "512m"). Default 1g.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_MEMORY.label: Memory limit
item.MCP_SANDBOX_NETWORK.description: Named network for sandboxes; empty uses the default bridge (direct egress). Pair with the egress firewall for isolation.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_NETWORK.label: Container network
item.MCP_SANDBOX_NO_NEW_PRIVS.descriptio: Blocks privilege escalation (setuid) inside the sandbox. On by default; set 0 to disable.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_NO_NEW_PRIVS.label: no-new-privileges
item.MCP_SANDBOX_PAUSE_AFTER_MS.descript: Idle time before a sandbox is paused (frozen, cheap to resume). Defaults to the idle TTL.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_PAUSE_AFTER_MS.label: Pause-after-idle (ms)
item.MCP_SANDBOX_PIDS.description: Max processes per sandbox (fork-bomb guard). Default 256.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_PIDS.label: PID limit
item.MCP_SANDBOX_READONLY_ROOT.descripti: Mounts the container root read-only. Off by default (npm install writes to the FS). Set 1 to harden.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_READONLY_ROOT.label: Read-only root filesystem
item.MCP_SANDBOX_RUNTIME.description: Which OCI runtime backs sandboxes. "auto" detects podman/docker; force one to avoid the probe.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_RUNTIME.label: Container runtime
item.MCP_SANDBOX_SECCOMP.description: Path to a seccomp JSON profile; empty uses the runtime default. Point at the stricter MCP profile to deny mount/unshare/bpf.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_SECCOMP.label: Seccomp profile path
item.MCP_SANDBOX_STATS_MS.description: How often the manager samples per-container CPU/memory stats. Default 15000 (15s).
item.MCP_SANDBOX_STATS_MS.label: Stats poll interval (ms)
item.MCP_SANDBOX_USER.description: Non-root user the sandbox process runs as. Default 1000:1000.
item.MCP_SANDBOX_USER.label: Container user (uid:gid)
item.MCP_SUBORDINATE_MASTER_WAIT_MS.desc: Safety deadline for a subordinate blocked on ask_master / submit_plan_to_master / submit_tasks_to_master. If the Master never answers (crashed/ended with the supervisor off) the subordinate is unblocked with an error so it proceeds on its own instead of hanging forever. Long by design — never fires in a healthy session. Default 1800000 (30 min).
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_ENABLED.description: Detects stuck company agents and recovers them (resume / resurrect master / unwedge tool), with circuit breakers to bound retries. The single biggest guard against a frozen company session. On by default; set to 0 to disarm. Applies to sessions started after you toggle it; watch incidents in Admin → Supervisor.
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_ENABLED.label: Agent supervisor (auto-recover stuck agents)
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_PERSISTENCE.descript: Persists supervisor state to agent_supervision so a restart can detect agents whose process died mid-run and mark them terminal. Set 0 to keep the supervisor in-memory only. Only relevant when the supervisor is enabled.
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_PERSISTENCE.label: Supervisor persistence (ghost cleanup on boot)
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_RECOVERY_MODE.descri: How the supervisor reacts to a stuck tool call. "inject" (default) unwedges the single call with a synthetic error so the run continues; "abort" terminates the whole runner instead; "read_only" detects + logs incidents but never acts; "off" disables recovery (detection only). Only relevant when the supervisor is enabled.
item.MCP_SUPERVISOR_RECOVERY_MODE.label: Supervisor recovery mode
item.MCP_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS.description: How long to coalesce file-change bursts (git checkout, formatter sweeps) before re-indexing.
item.MCP_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS.label: Watcher debounce (ms)
item.MCP_WATCH_MAX_PROJECTS.description: LRU cap on concurrently watched projects — beyond it the least-recently-opened watcher stops.
item.MCP_WATCH_MAX_PROJECTS.label: Max watched projects
item.ZAI_MAX_TOKENS.description: Cap on completion length for GLM models. 32000 covers most coding tasks.
item.ZAI_MAX_TOKENS.label: Z.AI max output tokens
